llm.summary: The skill's description matches its behavior, but its runtime instructions depend on missing local reference files and leave broad discretion to inspect code/PRs without specifying how that data should be provided, which is an incoherence you should address before installing.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (Swift architecture guidance, playbooks, checklists) align with the SKILL.md instructions. However, the instructions explicitly tell the agent to 'load references/*.md' (selection-guide.md, mvvm.md, etc.), but those reference files are not present in the skill bundle. That mismatch means the skill can't fulfill parts of its stated purpose as-is.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The workflow asks the agent to 'load' local reference files and to 'analyze existing codebase' and produce line-level PR fixes. The skill does not include the referenced files and does not specify how the agent should obtain repository/PR data (user-supplied snippets vs. direct repo access). This ambiguity could cause the agent to request broad access to your code or to proceed based on unstated assumptions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code files beyond SKILL.md, so nothing is written to disk and no external packages are fetched. This minimizes install-time risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables or credentials, which is appropriate for an architecture advisor. That said, the runtime behavior expects access to code/PR content; the SKILL.md doesn't require or describe credentials or repo scopes, creating a gap between expected inputs and declared requirements.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Flags show always:false and normal autonomous invocation allowed. The skill does not request persistent privileges or system-level configuration changes in its instructions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm where the referenced 'references/*.md' files live (they are not bundled). Ask the publisher to include those reference files or to update the SKILL.md to explain how the agent should obtain them. Decide how you want the agent to access code/PRs: prefer providing minimal, explicit code snippets in the conversation rather than granting repository/CI access. If you must grant repo access for in-place PR review, restrict scopes and test on a non-sensitive repo first. Finally, verify and review any line-level fixes the agent proposes before applying them.
